CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_subtask_due_date_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.due_date is distinct from old.due_date
     or new.due_date_change_reason is distinct from old.due_date_change_reason
     or new.due_date_changed_at is distinct from old.due_date_changed_at
     or new.due_date_changed_by is distinct from old.due_date_changed_by then
    if coalesce(current_setting('eflow.subtask_deadline_authorized', true), 'off') <> 'on' then
      raise exception 'Use the managed subtask deadline action to change a due date'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root uuid, p_node uuid, p_replace_lead boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(eflow_r7.manage(p_root,p_node,p_replace_lead),false) or (
  coalesce(eflow_r7.read_root(p_root),false) and exists (
   select 1 from (select eflow_r7.root(p_root) r) x where r->>'kind'='office'
    and coalesce((r->>'open')::boolean,false)
    and eflow_publication.planning_lead((r->>'project')::uuid,(r->>'office')::uuid)
  ));
$function$
